description: Catalano — Colore: Bone & gold texture Codice: 5749 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Floral Scala: Small Altezza: 138 cm Rapporto: 125 cm × 65.5 cm Toni: White Overgrown and sensuous, CATALANO is an impenetrable pattern of twisting and contorting ivy vines. CATALANO’s lush foliage strikes curiosity in everyone, particularly Mariano Fortuny, who returned to this pattern throughout his life. Mariano Fortuny first used CATALANO in his original tapestries and velvet garments and later refined the motif for printed cotton.
